what_this_is: Addresses this site once published and has since republished under the address rule (the work id's last segment). A published address is a promise a reader may have kept — it must keep answering, as a redirect to where the work now lives. Rows are recorded events, dated; the door builder reads this file and emits one redirect stub per row.

republished.why: the address was typed by hand during the proof-of-concept; the address rule derives i-kings from the work id
